title: CHUYÊN ĐỀ 8 MỆNH ĐỀ QUAN HỆ HSA - ĐỀ LUYỆN TẬP SỐ 2
notes: Chưa có đáp án trong dữ liệu nguồn; hệ thống không chấm điểm đề này.

questions.content: The charitable organization is looking for dedicated volunteers ______ are willing to spend their weekends helping elderly people in rural areas.
We visited the ancient castle ______ was built in the 14th century and remains one of the most popular tourist attractions in Europe.
My younger brother, ______ dream is to become a professional astronaut, spends all his free time studying physics and astronomy at the library.
I will never forget the summer of 2015 ______ our entire family traveled across the country in an old, cramped but reliable caravan.
The new shopping mall, ______ was officially opened by the mayor last week, features over two hundred international brands and a huge cinema.
The professor ______ lectures are always packed with students is known for his innovative approach to teaching modern history and political science.
Is there any specific reason ______ you decided to cancel the meeting at such short notice without informing the rest of the team?
The small village ______ my grandmother was born and raised has changed significantly over the last few decades due to rapid urbanization.
The mysterious man ______ we saw lurking near the entrance of the bank has finally been identified by the local police department.
All the documents ______ were left on the desk last night have been moved to the filing cabinet by the office cleaner.
This is the exact spot ______ the famous explorer first set foot on the continent several hundred years ago according to historical records.
Mr. Henderson, ______ is the head of the marketing department, is going to deliver a keynote speech at the international business conference tomorrow.
The heavy rain ______ started early this morning has caused several major traffic jams throughout the metropolitan area and the surrounding suburbs.
I finally managed to find the book ______ I had been searching for in every local bookstore for more than three consecutive months.
The children, ______ were playing football in the narrow street, accidentally broke one of the large windows of the neighbor’s house.
Do you remember the name of the hotel ______ we stayed during our first vacation to the coast about ten years ago?
The woman ______ you were talking to at the party is a world-renowned surgeon who specializes in complex cardiovascular procedures.
The company is developing a new type of battery ______ can be fully charged in less than five minutes and lasts for days.
1969 was the historic year ______ the first human beings successfully landed on the moon and returned safely back to Earth.
My best friend, ______ lives in a small apartment in Tokyo, is currently working as a freelance translator for several gaming companies.
The scientific committee interviewed several candidates, many of ______ possessed impressive academic credentials but lacked practical field experience in biology.
It was a highly complex and sensitive situation ______ I had absolutely no prior experience or clear instructions on how to proceed.
The startup company, ______ assets were seized by the bank last month, is now facing multiple lawsuits from its former employees and investors.
The conference provided a unique platform ______ experts from various disciplines could exchange ideas and collaborate on sustainable energy solutions.
We were forced to postpone the construction project, the main reason ______ was the unexpected shortage of raw materials in the global market.
The witness, from ______ the police obtained a detailed description of the suspect, has been placed under 24-hour protection for her safety.
The research paper, the findings ______ have been debated by scholars for years, suggests that climate change is accelerating faster than predicted.
There are several factors contributing to the economic downturn, the most significant of ______ is the rising cost of living and inflation.
The grand cathedral, the spire ______ can be seen from miles away, is considered a masterpiece of Gothic architecture in Western Europe.
He finally achieved his lifelong ambition of climbing Mount Everest, ______ was something he had been training for since his early twenties.
The manager hired three new assistants, the most experienced of ______ had previously worked for a multinational corporation in London for five years.
The legal framework ______ the new regulations are based is intended to protect consumers from fraudulent activities in the digital marketplace.
We reached a remote area of the jungle ______ no human being had ever set foot before, according to our local indigenous guides.
The novelist, ______ latest book has become a global bestseller, refused to give any interviews or make public appearances for several months.
The environmental crisis is a global issue, to ______ there is no simple or immediate solution without international cooperation and drastic policy changes.
They have designed a sophisticated software program, the purpose ______ is to detect and eliminate potential security threats in real-time.
The antique vase, ______ had been passed down through several generations, was unfortunately shattered into pieces during the move to the new house.
The university offers a wide range of extracurricular activities, ______ are designed to help students develop leadership skills and social responsibility.
The professor spoke about the industrial revolution, ______ period he described as a turning point in the history of human civilization and technology.
She is a woman for ______ I have the greatest respect, not only for her professional achievements but also for her immense kindness.
The philosophical treatise, ______ subtle nuances are often misunderstood by modern readers, requires a deep understanding of the historical context in which it was written.
He was accompanied by a group of bodyguards, ______ primary responsibility was to ensure his safety during his high-profile visit to the conflict zone.
The complex geopolitical situation is a delicate matter __________ the government is currently deeply concerned.
The prestigious scholarship, __________ was officially announced by the university board last week, aims to support exceptionally talented students from underprivileged backgrounds.
The diplomat, to ______ the secret documents had been entrusted, was found dead in his hotel room under extremely suspicious and unexplained circumstances.
The delicate negotiations reached a critical juncture, __________ the future of the entire coalition depended on a single compromise.
They live in a society ______ traditional values are increasingly being challenged by the rapid influx of Western culture and modern lifestyle choices.
The judge, ______ impartiality has never been questioned throughout his long and distinguished career, will preside over the most controversial trial of the decade.
The concept of absolute infinity is a complex mathematical paradox, __________ many eminent scholars have devoted their entire lives to studying.
The government has decided to implement a strict carbon tax on heavy industries, __________ many environmentalists have expressed their strong approval.
